verdict.rationale: Flagsmith does have automations: Release Pipelines and Scheduled Flags. But nothing in the pack shows those automations can be versioned, reviewed as definitions, or rolled back. Change Requests offer four-eyes review of flag changes and audit logs retrace flag, identity and segment values; both cover flag changes rather than the automations themselves, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit. Rollback of a pipeline or schedule is not evidenced at all.
